Package com.lemarketjames.auth

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.auth.AuthService
@Service public class AuthService extends Object
Service class providing authentication and authorization business logic. Handles user registration, login, password encoding, and token generation.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public AuthService.AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest request)
      Registers a new user with the provided registration request. Validates the request, checks for duplicate usernames, and stores the user with an encoded password.
      Parameters:
      request - the registration request containing user details
      Returns:
      an AuthResponse with the registered username and success message
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if validation fails or username is already taken

    • login

      public AuthService.LoginResult login(LoginRequest request)
      Authenticates a user with the provided login credentials. Validates the request and verifies the password against the stored hash.
      Parameters:
      request - the login request containing username and password
      Returns:
      a LoginResult with the username, success message, and JWT token
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if validation fails or credentials are invalid
